scope: retained preview transactions, independent map/voxel inputs, rendering retry, cancellation/clear and display-only framing
checks: generation and view reset retain existing map/voxel buffers; scalar publication keeps independently owned voxels and biome access
failed/cancelled generation and map admission preserve the committed display and provenance
generated voxels survive mesh failure; pending cross-sections retry rendering without generation; texture replacement after a scalar preview rebuilds retained 3D
resource-pack handoff cancels an obsolete mesh and publishes the same generated result through the new stack
biome slices keep their last valid data on invalid Y; read-only details report actual retained inputs
debounced input changes cancel work immediately and reschedule even before the first successful field; Cancel clears queued work
retained-map drag uses actual X/Z coverage and rejects replaced map ownership
explicit clear releases pending/committed preview ownership and ignores late results without changing stored cells
limits: Actual application functions with controlled engine/render/DOM/timer services and tiny stored data only. No native build, terrain/registry/state sweep, broad suite or GitHub workflow. Map and voxel rendering remain independently retained; one pending voxel result may coexist with the committed result. Inputs are descriptive metadata, not replayable engine snapshots. Real browser UI/GPU/cancellation interleavings and total memory remain unqualified.
